visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark blue faucet pours clear water into a white ceramic bowl filled with dried oats. The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking directly down at the bowl. (2) A wooden spoon enters from the right side of the frame to stir the oat mixture as more water is added. (3) A hand with white and gold patterned nail art cracks two eggs into a small red pot sitting on a black induction stove; the yolks are a vibrant orange. (4) The same hand uses a wooden spoon to stir the eggs into a pale yellow, bubbling liquid within the pot. (5) A hand opens the silver door of a toaster oven or air fryer, revealing a white plate stacked with browned, chopped pieces of steak. (6) A hand adds a large handful of fresh, dark green spinach leaves into the boiling yellow soup mixture in the red pot. (7) The soup is stirred again with the wooden spoon, showing the steak pieces and spinach fully integrated into the broth. (8) A final shot displays the finished dish served in a bowl, followed by a close-up of a brown tabby cat looking directly into the camera lens.
